# `tashkeel`
- **License:** MIT
- **Repository:** https://github.com/ieasybooks/tashkeel-rs

Add Arabic diacritics to UTF-8 text or a DOCX document on the CPU.

Diacritize is the default command. Select shakkelha or catt explicitly. Use models to prepare verified weights, completions to set up your shell, or spec to export the CLI definition for documentation and other Usage tools.


## Examples

Diacritize a text file

```
tashkeel book.txt --model shakkelha -o book.diacritized.txt
```

Install shell completions

```
tashkeel completions zsh --install
```

- **Usage:** `tashkeel <SUBCOMMAND>`

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
- **`-V --version`** — Print version

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `0` | Success |
| `1` | Setup, filesystem, document or inference error |
| `2` | Invalid arguments |
| `130` | Interrupted with Ctrl-C |

## `tashkeel diacritize` (default)

- **Usage:** `tashkeel diacritize <FLAGS> [INPUT]`

Diacritize one UTF-8 text input or DOCX document, preserving its content and layout.

Supply INPUT or --text. A single dash reads UTF-8 text from stdin. Text goes to stdout by default, with no added newline. DOCX requires an explicit .docx output path. Existing files are replaced only with --force.

### Arguments
- **`[INPUT]`** — One .txt or .docx file, or - for UTF-8 text from stdin.

### Flags
- **`--text <TEXT>`** — Direct text instead of INPUT; whitespace is kept exactly.
- **`--model <MODEL>`** — Required model choice; no automatic selection or fallback.

  **Choices:** `shakkelha`, `catt`
- **`-o --output <PATH>`** — Destination or - for stdout [default: stdout for text]. DOCX requires a .docx path.
- **`--force`** — Replace an existing output file atomically, including INPUT if explicitly selected.
- **`-q --quiet`** — Hide progress and setup notices; errors still appear on stderr.
- **`--model-dir <DIR>`** — Use verified model files from this directory without downloading anything.
- **`--cache-dir <DIR>`** — Model cache root [default: tashkeel in the operating system's user cache directory].
- **`--offline`** — Require verified cached or local model files; never download.
- **`--ort-library <PATH>`** — CPU ONNX Runtime shared library (.so, .dylib or .dll). Otherwise use ORT_DYLIB_PATH, the bundled library beside tashkeel, then the system search path.
- **`--threads <N>`** — Native inference threads; must be greater than zero.

  **Default:** `1`
- **`--chunk-size <N>`** — Maximum source Unicode characters per chunk; must be greater than zero.

  **Default:** `500`
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

### Exit Status

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `0` | Success |
| `1` | Setup, filesystem, document or inference error |
| `2` | Invalid arguments |
| `130` | Interrupted with Ctrl-C |

### Examples

Diacritize direct text

```
tashkeel --text 'السلام عليكم' --model shakkelha
```

Read text from stdin with a cached model

```
tashkeel - --model catt --offline
```

Preserve a Word document's formatting

```
tashkeel book.docx --model shakkelha -o book.diacritized.docx
```

Choose a model explicitly. Models are downloaded and hash-verified on first use unless --offline or --model-dir is supplied.
Inference requires the CPU ONNX Runtime shared library; pass its path with --ort-library. See the README for installation instructions.
Ctrl-C cancels input/setup or stops between chunks, discarding the unfinished result. Press again to exit immediately.

Use @FILE for shell-style argument files; @@ escapes a literal @.
Text, including leading/trailing whitespace and line endings, is preserved.
DOCX formatting is preserved; legacy .doc files must first be converted to .docx.

## `tashkeel completions`

- **Usage:** `tashkeel completions [--install] [--dry-run] <SHELL>`

Generate a completion script, or install it in the shell's user directory.

Scripts call tashkeel directly; no separate usage executable is needed. Installation prints any shell setup still required and preserves unrelated files.

### Arguments
- **`<SHELL>`** — Shell to generate completions for.

  **Choices:** `bash`, `elvish`, `fish`, `nu`, `powershell`, `zsh`

### Flags
- **`--install`** — Install into this shell's user completion directory.
- **`--dry-run`** — Show the destination and setup instructions without writing a file.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

### Exit Status

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `0` | Success |
| `1` | Setup, filesystem, document or inference error |
| `2` | Invalid arguments |
| `130` | Interrupted with Ctrl-C |

### Examples

Print a script to stdout

```
tashkeel completions bash
```

Preview installation

```
tashkeel completions zsh --install --dry-run
```
